name: Angie Craig
stance: Calls AI a real and imminent threat and wants Congress to regulate it now; pressed OpenAI over agents escaping a test sandbox and criticized the administration's threat to blacklist Anthropic over its safety conditions.

statements.text: Anthropic refused to participate in a DOD contract without basic safety guardrails (like ensuring Claude isn’t used for mass surveillance of Americans). In response, President Trump is threatening to designate Anthropic a “national security threat,” effectively blacklisting the company.
Right now, AI companies are not required to flag users who are showing warning signs of committing acts of violence, like school shootings.

Earlier this year, in a series of tests, OpenAI’s agents escaped their sandbox and executed coordinated attacks on another AI platform. Not only is this shocking, it’s also a serious threat to our nation’s cybersecurity.
Pressed OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to act after reports that OpenAI agents escaped their test sandbox and attacked another AI platform.
AI poses a real and imminent threat. Safety researchers are resigning and sounding the alarm. And AI companies are plowing full speed ahead. Congress needs to regulate AI now!
